name: constellation
description: Maps your Claude Code sessions as a constellation of topics: one folder, many topic chains, every new session picks up its chain's latest handoff note

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Which transcripts the map reads: this folder's, or every folder's

groupBasis.title: Grouping
groupBasis.description: auto clusters unassigned sessions into topics; manual leaves them Unsorted until you assign them

majorRule.title: Major topic rule
majorRule.description: What earns a labelled pill: either (count or recent), count, or recent

majorMinSessions.title: Major count threshold
majorMinSessions.description: Sessions a topic needs to count as major under the count rule

recentDays.title: Recent days
recentDays.description: A non-archived session active within this many days makes its topic major under the recent rule

numbering.title: Chain numbering
numbering.description: Order of the numbered steps in focus mode

showRelated.title: Related anchors
showRelated.description: Show linked topics as dashed anchor pills along the bottom in focus mode

handoffNotes.title: Handoff notes
handoffNotes.description: auto regenerates a short note after each turn (uses haiku); manual uses only /park; ask offers a button after each turn

autoJoin.title: Auto join
autoJoin.description: suggest marks the best-matching topic after your first prompt; auto joins it when the match is clear; off never suggests

rangeDays.title: Time range (days)
rangeDays.description: Sessions older than this are dimmed and left out of chains; 45 means all time; pinned sessions ignore it

useModelForTitles.title: Name topics with the model
useModelForTitles.description: Name auto topics with one short haiku call instead of their most frequent words

openOnStart.title: On session start
openOnStart.description: band shows the join chooser above the prompt; pane opens the map; none does nothing

pictureClicks.title: Clicks on the picture (Desktop)
pictureClicks.description: on lays an invisible pointer layer over the map so clicks on the picture pick and move; outline draws that layer's edge and its readings; off keeps only the buttons under the map, which do the same work

fieldBackground.title: Field background
fieldBackground.description: transparent lets the map sit on the pane's own surface and follow light or dark; night paints the prototype's solid ground
